WHAT TO DO IN CASE OF AN
EMERGENCY LANDING
-Remain calm and follow instructions from the
crew.
-Sit back as far as possible in the seat and tighten
seat belt.
-Assume one of the two positions illustrated and
maintain position until aircraft comes to a stop.
-When aircraft has come to a complete stop,
unfasten seat belt and follow instructions from
the crew.
MEDIDAS A TOMAR EN CASO DE
ATERRIZAJE DE EMERGENCIA
—Permanezca calmado y obedezca las instruccio-
nes de los tripulantes.
-Acomódese bien en el asiento y apriete su
cinturón de seguridad.
-Colóquese en una de las dos posiciones ilustra-
das y mantenga esa posición hasta que el avión
se detenga.
-Cuando el avión haya detenido su marcha por
completo, desabroche el cinturón y obedezca las
instrucciones de los tripulantes.

FEDERAL REQUIREMENTS
FOR EMERGENCY EXIT ROW SEATING CRITERIA
For the safety and comfort of our passengers, Federal Aviation Regulations state that
no person may occupy an exit row seat if that person is unable to perform one or more
of the functions listed on the emergency exits, because:
• The person lacks suficient mobility, strength, or dexterity in both arms and hands
and both legs:
To reach upward, sideways, and downwards to the location of emergency exit
operating mechanisms.
To grasp and push, pull, turn, or otherwise manipulate those mechanisms.
To push, shove, pull or otherwise open emergency exits.
To remove obstructions of size and weight similar to the Exit doors.
To reach the emergency exit expeditiously, to maintain balance while removing
obstructions, to exit expeditiously.
• The person is less than 15 years of age.
• The person lacks the ability to read and understand instructions related to
emergency evacuation provided by the certificate holder in printed, handwritten or
graphic form or the ability to understand the oral crew commands in the English language.
•The person lacks suficient aural capacity to hear and understand instructions
shouted by flight crewmembers without assistance beyond a hearing aid.
• The person lacks the ability adequately to impart information orally to other
passengers, or the person has a condition or responsibilities such as caring for small
children that might prevent the person from performing one or more of the applicable
funcions listed in paragraphs of this section, or a condition that might cause the person
harm if he or she performs one or more of the applicable functions listed in paragraphs
of this section.
• If you feel you have a non desirable condition that will prevent you from performing
the applicable functions listed based on this criteria, please inform the Customer Service
Agent or a Flight Crewmember for alternate seating arrangements.
THANK YOU FOR FLYING SUNAIRE EXPRESS
